name: Kadri Coffee
context: People who drink coffee every day and want good coffee without the ceremony. Direct, warm, concrete. Never imply certifications, health benefits or a sourcing story we cannot prove.
notes: Wordmark spelling supplied (locked): "kadri", all lowercase. The wordmark slot is left empty on purpose: the owner supplied the k symbol as the logo and no wordmark file, and typing "kadri" in Hubot Sans next to the k would be our drawing of their wordmark, not their file. Ask for the wordmark file. logo-reversed.svg (the dark k) is kept in brand/assets/ as a supplied file; since contract 1.4 the accent scheme renders it (poligraf.config.json brand.assets.logoReversed, tokens.css --brand-logo-variant).
